note: Saved by the orchestrator (condensed). Persona is Italy-led, so relevance is capped for every non-Italy country guide (known issue; persona widening offered to the user).

decision.reason: Not Italy; solid sourced paperwork; concierge paragraph is brochure language with no names, fees or track record; Delta Goodrem link reads as polish.

findings.issue: Fear 1 (wrong planner, kickbacks) only touched; 'partnered planner' raises the referral question (CONCIERGE-PAY).
Fear 2 (planning from Sydney) only touched; no named person or response expectations.
Company claims ('800+ weddings in 54 countries') unsupported by destination or Australian detail.
'Ask the Public Registry' repeated across many rows; feels unfinished.
Jargon-dense tables (RZ1, RZ2, banns, Free Status, CNI, apostille) hard on a phone.
Delta Goodrem link reads as Instagram polish.
H2 'Can't marry legally in Malta?' contradicts the line below it.
Fear 3 (overcharged as foreigners) ignored; Registry fee table feels irrelevant at this budget.

praised: Arrive two days ahead for the Registrar appointment
payload.in_their_words: Actually quite a thorough rundown of the forms... but every second line says to ask the Registry, and the bit about their own service is all 'trusted planners' with no names or prices.
